system.description:
Touch; one flask of water; permanent until used.

  • Makes holy water, as described in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.
  • Cast reversed (Curse Water): makes unholy water, which works the same way but deals 2d4 necrotic damage to Good creatures instead.
  • Material: silver dust worth 25 gp, consumed.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric, Paladin
